top_signals.title: Safety Should Be Provable, Not Just Compliant
top_signals.summary:
A unanimous Supreme Court ruling means freight brokers can face state liability claims for their selection of carriers. For carriers, that shift turns a documented safety program from a compliance nicety into a competitive credential. In an upcoming webinar, Lytx® outlines the elements of a defensible safety record.

The post Safety Should Be Provable, Not Just Compliant appeared first on FreightWaves.
